messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem meeting earlier. We need to lock owners and timelines for the remediation items and decide who writes the customer-facing summary.
kevin: /agree. I'll take ownership of the autoscaler fix (AI-321). ETA end of next week. Will open PR today.
ash: I'll own the runbook updates to prevent recurrence. Target: EOD Thursday. Adding steps for fast fallback.
eli: Support needs a short public summary template we can paste into Zendesk replies. Meera, can you help?
meera: Yes — I can draft the public summary. Proposal: publish a short status page update within 12 hours, then a concise incident summary within 48 hours, and the full RCA after internal review (no more than 7 days).
kevin: Sounds reasonable. For the public summary wording: avoid technical kernel dumps. Keep it: impact, customer mitigation, what's next. Example: "We experienced degraded API throughput; requests were retried automatically; fix deployed at 14:12 UTC; full RCA forthcoming." :+1:
sara: Agree. Also we should be explicit about what we will not share publicly (e.g., detailed internal logs, exact patch diffs). Add that to the playbook.
incident-bot: Reminder: vendor SLA contact list and compliance redaction checklist attached to the incident doc.
meera: Draft public summary (short):
```
We experienced elevated API latency impacting a subset of hosted inference requests from 13:10–14:15 UTC. Customer requests were retried; no data loss reported. We deployed a rollback at 14:12 UTC which restored normal service. A follow-up incident summary with next steps and root cause will be posted within 48 hours.
```
eli: That's perfect. Can we add a line about who to contact for ongoing customer impact reporting?
meera: Added: "If you need help or have ongoing impact, contact support@redwood.com with your request ID."
kevin: For remediation tracking — let's use the incident board ticket. Owners, due dates, and PR links in the incident board. I'll add AI-321 and link PR when ready.
sara: Action items recapped:
- kevin: autoscaler fix (AI-321) — due 2026-03-29
- ash: runbook + rollback steps — due 2026-03-26
- meera: public summary + 48h incident summary — first draft in 12 hrs
- ops: add redaction policy note to postmortem — assigned to sara, due 2026-04-01
Please update the board when items change. We should review recurring pattern notes — there were similar latency incidents in Jan/Feb; add to trend line for Q2.
ash: I'll add runbook PR link when done. Also we should schedule a follow-up recurring incident review meeting next week.
eli: Support will send an outbound to affected customers after the 12-hour summary is live. I'll coordinate timings with Meera.
sara: Thanks all. I'll post the public summary to the status page after Meera's sign-off. Keep updates short. :eyes:
